About the role 
We are looking for a Marketing Specialist to join our team and support field marketing programs and events across EMEA. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves bringing events to life and driving engagement that supports pipeline generation.
In this role, you will be involved across the full event lifecycle, from venue and vendor coordination to invitations, registration, shipments, swag, onsite logistics, and post-event follow-up, across industry conferences, executive dinners, partner events, workshops, webinars, and Starburst-hosted experiences. 
This role is best suited for someone resourceful and proactive who is comfortable juggling multiple priorities and excited to roll up their sleeves in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
As a Senior Marketing Specialist at Starburst you will : 
Support the execution of marketing programs, including industry conferences, executive dinners, workshops, meetups, partner programs, and Starburst-hosted events.
Work closely with the Marketing Manager, EMEA to coordinate event calendar, timelines, budget and general operations.
Handle day-to-day event logistics, including venues, vendors, catering, AV, shipments, swag, and booth materials, and support onsite setup, registration, and teardown.
Build and launch event invitations, registration pages, and email communications and keep campaign and attendee data up-to-date.
Maintain event calendars, project trackers, budgets, registration lists, and program documentation.
Coordinate with Creative, Content, Digital, Social Media, Comms, and Operations teams to deliver event assets and keep programs consistent and on brand.
Maintain promotional inventory and apply brand standards across all field programs.
Track and report attendance, engagement, costs, leads, MQLs, and pipeline contribution to measure performance and inform future programs.
Research venues, vendors, conferences, and sponsorship opportunities across EMEA markets as needed.
Some of the things we look for: 
1-3 years of experience in a field marketing, events marketing, or similar role 
Hands-on experience coordinating events, meetings, conferences, or similar programs.
Strong organisational and project management skills with excellent attention to detail.
Comfortable managing multiple events, deadlines, and logistics simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Collaborative, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
Resourceful and proactive, able to spot problems and help solve them quickly.
Additional European languages are a plus.
Ability to Travel: This role will require 25% in-person travel for purposes including but not limited to key programs and events, new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.
Where could this role be based? 
London, United Kingdom
Starburst is dedicated to maintaining fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range provided for this role reflects the minimum and maximum targets for candidates in the country in which the role is located and could be inclusive of variable compensation, such as commission or bonus. All full-time employees receive equity grants (NSOs), and depending on the country, may have access to additional employer-sponsored benefits. Actual compensation packages are determined based on relevant skills, experience, education and training, and specific work location. For more information, connect with the recruiting team or Hiring Manager during the interview process as they can provide more detailed information about the salary range.
Pay Range
£55,000 — £71,000 GBP 
Build your career at Starburst 
All-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we’re empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry-proven technology and unprecedented success, All-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry – and the future. 
Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more. 
We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All-Stars to show up authentically.

postings.wholeText:
As a Growth Marketing Executive at Treatwell you will play a pivotal role in driving Treatwell’s user acquisition strategy across all our 13 markets. Operating at the intersection of data, media buying, and creative strategy, this role involves managing and scaling performance marketing campaigns to acquire new customers and maximise revenue for the business. You will be responsible for turning ad spend into measurable growth across multiple European markets.
This is a highly dynamic role where you’ll experiment with creative growth strategies across all business areas, collaborate closely with our brand, design and data teams, and help shape Treatwell’s overall growth trajectory.
🧐 You will be responsible for: 
Paid Media Execution - Launch, manage, and optimise paid social and paid search campaigns, ensuring a balance between creative impact, audience segmentation, and advanced bidding strategies.
Campaign Optimisation - Develop and execute high-performing campaigns across Google, Meta, Snapchat, Pinterest, Apple Search Ads and TikTok by testing audience targeting, creative and messaging. Knowledge of affiliate campaigns would be a plus.
Creative Development - Work closely with our design and content teams to ideate, test, and optimise creative assets that drive engagement and conversion. Ensure ad creatives are localized, relevant, and high-performing. An interest in creating or filming UGC content would also be a big plus! 
A/B Testing & Experimentation : Run continuous experiments on ad copy, creative assets, targeting audiences, and landing pages to optimize conversion rates and unlock new growth loops.
Budget & Bidding Optimization : Manage large budgets and bidding strategies across platforms to keep metrics like ROAS and CAC in check.
Performance Analysis & Reporting - Track, analyse, and report on campaign performance, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to refine strategies and improve efficiency. 
Emerging Trends & Innovation - Stay ahead of industry trends and proactively implement AI advancements and automated workflows to streamline campaign management and identify untapped growth potential.
Collaboration & Integration - Work cross-functionally with internal teams, including Brand, CRM, Data and Local Marketing to ensure seamless execution of growth initiatives.
